desktop.notes: • ★ Suggest favourites is now a mode of the grid, not a window (computer and phone): the grid shows only the suggestions, each with a dashed yellow frame; take one with F (computer) or a double-tap (phone) and it turns solid ★. Everything else works as usual - thumbnail size, viewer, zoom, compare, the details panel (which says why each one is suggested). A bar on top: how many (Top 10 / 25 / 50 / 100 - only sizes that fit - or All strong with the count: only photos that pass the quality bar, one per burst / similar set), what is taken, "Make the other N ★", Close / Done.
